Welder – MIG/MAG and TIG

Steelform AB manufactures load-bearing steel structures for bridges and industrial buildings. Our workshop in Borlänge has 85 employees.

Responsibilities
- Weld steel structures in MIG/MAG and TIG according to drawings and welding procedure specifications
- Prepare and fit parts before welding, and grind and finish the welds
- Check your own work and document it according to our quality system

Requirements
- Valid welding certificates according to EN ISO 9606-1
- Several years of experience welding steel structures
- Able to read technical drawings

Benefits
- Permanent position after six months
- Work clothes and safety equipment provided
- Overtime compensation and a staff canteen
